observation.visible_scene: A tennis ball impacts a racket strung with purple powder against a solid orange background, captured in slow motion.
visible_changes: The ball descends from the top of the frame and strikes the center of the racket strings.
The strings deform downwards under the impact, creating a pocket in which the ball sinks.
A cloud of purple powder is displaced from the strings, expanding upwards and outwards into the air.
The ball moves laterally across the string bed towards the left side of the racket frame while embedded.
The ball rebounds upwards and to the left, eventually exiting the top-left of the frame.
The perspective of the racket shifts significantly, tilting from a top-down view to a more side-angled view throughout the clip.
The powder cloud continues to rise and disperse in the air after the ball has left the racket.
outside_clip_unknowns: The initial trajectory or source of the ball before the clip starts.
Whether the racket is being held by an operator or is fixed in place.
The final state of the powder cloud after the clip ends.
uncertain_details: Whether the changing angle of the racket is due to camera movement or physical rotation of the racket itself, as the solid background provides no reference points.
